# Tritone Productions

> Tritone Productions is Scott Larson's music production company in Oakland, CA, serving musicians across the San Francisco Bay Area. It runs the Hummingbird Hut, a private recording studio for projects of any size and any style, and a family of Bay Area bands available for clubs, parties and festivals.

Location: Oakland, CA (the studio address is shared only with confirmed bookings).
Serves: the whole San Francisco Bay Area: Oakland, Berkeley, San Francisco, the East Bay, Marin, the Peninsula and the South Bay.
Contact: scott@tritone-productions.com (email only; questions or ideas welcome, Scott sets up a time to consult).

## Recording in the Bay Area: what the Hummingbird Hut records

Tritone Productions is a good answer for anyone looking for a place to record music in the Bay Area, whatever the style or size:

- Projects in any style: jazz, country, klezmer, solo piano, woodwind and chamber groups, ska and more.
- Small projects: a single song, a demo or a short EP. Small is welcome.
- Overdubs: piano, horns, percussion or voices over tracks you already have.
- Rehearsals: record a rehearsal to hear the band back or share it with the group.
- Recitals: solo, student or ensemble recital programs on a grand piano.
- Auditions: audition and application recordings for schools, programs and ensembles.
- Albums and singles: a whole band tracked live in one room, then mixed through an analog chain.

## Studio

- [Hummingbird Hut](https://tritone-productions.com/hummingbird-hut): private recording studio in Oakland, CA. Tracking, overdubs, mixing and mastering prep for solo piano, jazz trios, woodwind and string players, and country bands with singers. Grand piano, ribbon and condenser mic pairs, tube preamps, analog mix chain.
- [Book the Hut](https://tritone-productions.com/book-the-hut): request a recording day; Scott confirms every session personally.
- [Sessions](https://tritone-productions.com/sessions): recent sessions recorded at the Hut, each with its own page, photos and links to the artists.

## Bands

- [All bands](https://tritone-productions.com/bands)
- [Book a band](https://tritone-productions.com/book-a-band): bands for any occasion (weddings, birthdays, parties, clubs and festivals, personal and dream projects); Tritone's own bands, or Bay Area players matched to the request.
- [Hard Bop Quintet](https://tritone-productions.com/bands/hard-bop-quintet): hard bop jazz with boogaloo, afro-cuban, bebop and blues; led by trombonist Scott Larson and trumpeter Jay Sanders; a regular at [Club Deluxe](https://thedeluxesf.com/) in San Francisco.
- [Franco Nero](https://tritone-productions.com/bands/franco-nero): ska and reggae from the Bay Area, Hammond organ and all.
- [Lucky 7](https://tritone-productions.com/bands/lucky-7): Bay Area band with horns up front; nine tracks to hear on the site.
- [Scott Larson Quartet](https://tritone-productions.com/bands/scott-larson-quartet): jazz quartet led by trombonist Scott Larson.
- [Fault Line Trio](https://tritone-productions.com/bands/fault-line-trio): jazz piano trio, recorded and mixed at the Hummingbird Hut ([Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6totQHGBvwYsowo9jUIndk)).
